placement: Immediately after EarkSIPGenerator; success relationship routes to Add event.groovy.
purpose: Stages event.* and agent.* attributes so Add event.groovy emits an 'information package creation' NDJSON record describing the E-ARK SIP that EarkSIPGenerator just produced.

properties.event.detail: Opprettelse av E-ARK SIP i henhold til E-ARK Common Specification (CSIP) V.2.2.0, E-ARK SIP V.2.2.0 og Nasjonalbibliotekets spesifikasjoner SIP 1.0 (E-ARK).
properties.agent.name: Commons IP
properties.agent.note: Verktøy brukt for å opprette E-ARK SIP-pakker

notes: All four agent.* properties are required because agent.name is set — the Apache NiFi defaults in Add event.groovy only apply when agent.name is unset.
agent.version: 2.3.0 is from the DPS team's example. Verify it matches the commons-ip2 jar bundled in your nifi-nb-eark-nar, e.g.: unzip -l <path-to-nar> | grep commons-ip2
event.datetime uses the same #{timestamp} parameter context reference as the transfer-event UpdateAttribute.
